name: common-test-37d14c64be/option-rest-param-v.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature

## Invocations / ### Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
reason: The case requires command-line binding of --name Riyafa into the included Student record and conversion of positional strings 5 and 3 into the int rest parameter. Subset 10 supports these parameter forms in signatures and describes function-call argument binding, but does not cover command-line option parsing or main argument conversion. This essential @args behavior makes the whole case a feature.
unsupported_constructs: CLI option binding into an included record parameter and positional CLI conversion into an int rest parameter
test_design_notes: @args supplies ["--name", "Riyafa", "5", "3"]; assertions require student.name == "Riyafa" and ratings == [5, 3]. Signature support alone does not establish this runtime behavior.
